_doc: Goods hung from the store's beaded ceiling (#1182, G3): two cured hams in muslin on tarred cord, one hung lower than the other. A prop that hangs by a hook (GlassProp, as the hanging lamp: it swings when pushed, and falls whole if the board it hangs from goes; its parts never shatter). Baked the gun way (tools/blender/props/store_g3.py: model hung_ham). Written by tools/props/store_g3.py.
